summary: Model updated for the Engine-owned leader progress and commit path. Fresh traces validated, and bounded model checking found no implementation defect.
validation_limits: Model checking is bounded to 3 servers and small term/index/fault budgets; most update campaigns stopped at their 30-minute budget with states still queued (LIMITED_COVERAGE).
Message-level actions (SendAppendEntries, DeliverAppendEntries, RejectAppendConflict, HandleUpdateMatched, GrantVote) are not directly traced; their Engine cores are.
RejectAppendConflict and DiscardNegativeAck had no positive coverage at the explored depths.
OneOutstandingMembership is checked only in crash-free configurations because the restart path resets the volatile commit index (pre-existing Case A).
The U-S3 covered-but-unpromoted membership state was not reached in the model within budget; the implementation produces it only from a hand-built unit-test fixture.
RaftCore paths that change vote or role without clearing Engine leader data (install_snapshot, revert-to-follower) are outside the modeled Next relation.
